metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, you actually clicked?’ and enemy just paused LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that without even aiming?
Enemy must’ve been AFK or just really chill.
Click if your kills are more ‘lucky accident’ than skill!
Valorant logic: baffling but hilarious.

Tap if your kills look like accidents but feel like wins!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
